0;\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // MPI decomposition: this rank owns rows [rowBegin, rowBegin + numLocal)\n    int rank = 0, numRanks = 1;\n    int rowBegin = 0, numLocal = 0;\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts, rowDispls;\n\n    // Device data\n    Triangle* dTris = nullptr;\n    Vec3* dNormals = nullptr;\n    FlatNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    int* dLeafTris = nullptr;\n    val_t* dAreas = nullptr;\n    val_t* dKijT = nullptr;        // Local Kij (then weights), transposed: [j * numLocal + (i - rowBegin)]\n    uint8_t* dTauT = nullptr;      // Local Tau, transposed like dKijT\n    val_t* dRadB = nullptr;        // Full radiosity history (T x N)\n    val_t* dDist = nullptr;        // Local distances\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    const bool root = state.rank == 0;\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n    state.reflectivity = reflectivity;\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", n);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if (root) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(n);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Row decomposition\n    state.rowCounts.resize(state.numRanks);\n    state.rowDispls.resize(state.numRanks);\n    for (int r = 0; r < state.numRanks; ++r) {\n        size_t b = n * r / state.numRanks, e = n * (r + 1) / state.numRanks;\n        state.rowDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(b);\n        state.rowCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(e - b);\n    }\n    state.rowBegin = state.rowDispls[state.rank];\n    state.numLocal = state.rowCounts[state.rank];\n\n    // Device copies of the geometry\n    std::vector<FlatNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<int> leafTris;\n    int maxDepth = 0;\n    state.octree.flatten(nodes, leafTris, 0, maxDepth);\n    if (7 * maxDepth + 1 > OCT_STACK) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree too deep (%d) for traversal stack\\n\", maxDepth);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    std::vector<Vec3> normals(n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) normals[i] = state.triangles[i].normal();\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTris, n * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dNormals, n * sizeof(Vec3)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dNodes, nodes.size() * sizeof(FlatNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dLeafTris, std::max<size_t>(leafTris.size(), 1) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dAreas, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTris, state.triangles.data(), n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNormals, normals.data(), n * sizeof(Vec3), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodes, nodes.data(), nodes.size() * sizeof(FlatNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dLeafTris, leafTris.data(), leafTris.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    const size_t localElems = static_cast<size_t>(state.numLocal) * n;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dKijT, std::max<size_t>(localElems, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTauT, std::max<size_t>(localElems, 1) * sizeof(uint8_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dKijT, 0, std::max<size_t>(localElems, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRadB, std::max<size_t>(timesteps * n, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, std::max<size_t>(timesteps * n, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dDist, std::max(state.numLocal, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    state.distances.resize(n, ZERO);\n\n    // Source emission (active for first half of timesteps) is applied inside the\n    // simulation kernel: radE[t][source] = 1 for t < timesteps / 2.\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    const bool root = state.rank == 0;\n    if (root) printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Number of non-culled pairs per row -> position of every pair in the random stream\n    int* dRowCount = nullptr;\n    long long* dRowOffset = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dRowCount, n * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dRowOffset, (n + 1) * sizeof(long long)));\n    countActivePairsKernel<<<n, 256>>>(state.dNormals, n, dRowCount);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    std::vector<int> rowCount(n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(rowCount.data(), dRowCount, n * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    std::vector<long long> rowOffset(n + 1, 0);\n    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) rowOffset[i + 1] = rowOffset[i] + rowCount[i];\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dRowOffset, rowOffset.data(), (n + 1) * sizeof(long long), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const long long pairBegin = rowOffset[state.rowBegin];\n    const long long pairEnd = rowOffset[state.rowBegin + state.numLocal];\n    const long long localPairs = pairEnd - pairBegin;\n    const long long totalPairs = rowOffset[n];\n\n    if (localPairs > 0) {\n        // Chunking: power-of-two pairs per chunk, aiming for a few thousand blocks\n        long long pairsPerChunk = 64;\n        while (localPairs / pairsPerChunk > 4096) pairsPerChunk *= 2;\n        const long long numChunks = (localPairs + pairsPerChunk - 1) / pairsPerChunk;\n\n        // Jump polynomials x^(2^b) mod P for all bits of the largest stream offset\n        unsigned long long maxOffset = static_cast<unsigned long long>(totalPairs) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n        int bits = 1;\n        while (bits < 64 && (maxOffset >> bits) != 0) ++bits;\n        MtJumpTables tables;\n        tables.build(bits);\n\n        std::vector<uint32_t> seed = MtJumpTables::seedWindow();\n        uint32_t *dPolys = nullptr, *dSeed = nullptr, *dBase = nullptr, *dChunkStates = nullptr;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPolys, tables.powPolys.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dSeed, MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dBase, MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dChunkStates, static_cast<size_t>(numChunks) * MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPolys, tables.powPolys.data(), tables.powPolys.size() * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dSeed, seed.data(), MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        // State at this rank's first draw, then at each chunk start\n        mtJumpKernel<<<1, JUMP_THREADS>>>(dSeed, static_cast<unsigned long long>(pairBegin) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR, 0,\n                                          dPolys, dBase);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        mtJumpKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(numChunks), JUMP_THREADS>>>(\n            dBase, 0, static_cast<unsigned long long>(pairsPerChunk) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR, dPolys, dChunkStates);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        formFactorKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(numChunks), FF_THREADS>>>(\n            n, state.rowBegin, state.numLocal, pairBegin, pairEnd, pairsPerChunk,\n            dRowOffset, dChunkStates, state.dNormals, state.dTris, state.dNodes, state.dLeafTris,\n            state.dKijT);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPolys));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dSeed));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dBase));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dChunkStates));\n    }\n\n    // Count non-zero form factors and convert Kij into propagation weights\n    unsigned long long* dNonZero = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dNonZero, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dNonZero, 0, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    if (state.numLocal > 0) {\n        finalizeWeightsKernel<<<1024, 256>>>(state.dKijT, state.dAreas, n, state.numLocal, dNonZero);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    unsigned long long localNonZero = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&localNonZero, dNonZero, sizeof(unsigned long long), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localNonZero, &state.nonZeroKij, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dNonZero));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dRowCount));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dRowOffset));\n\n    if (root) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n                printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (state.rank == 0) printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t nLocal = static_cast<size_t>(state.numLocal);\n    if (nLocal == 0) return;\n\n    std::vector<uint8_t> tauT(n * nLocal);\n    int maxTau = 0;\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : maxTau)\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nLocal; ++li) {\n            size_t i = state.rowBegin + li;\n            int tau = 0;\n            if (i != j) tau = computeTau(state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n            maxTau = std::max(maxTau, tau);\n            tauT[j * nLocal + li] = static_cast<uint8_t>(tau);\n        }\n    }\n    if (maxTau > 255) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Time delay %d exceeds storage range\\n\", maxTau);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTauT, tauT.data(), n * nLocal, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    const bool root = state.rank == 0;\n    if (root) printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int nLocal = state.numLocal;\n    const int timeOff = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps / 2);\n    std::vector<val_t> hostRow(state.numRanks > 1 ? n : 0);\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        val_t* dRow = state.dRadB + t * n;\n        if (nLocal > 0) {\n            simulationStepKernel<<<(nLocal + SIM_THREADS - 1) / SIM_THREADS, SIM_THREADS>>>(\n                static_cast<int>(t), n, state.rowBegin, nLocal, state.dKijT, state.dTauT, state.dRadB,\n                state.reflectivity, static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex), timeOff);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n        if (state.numRanks > 1) {\n            if (nLocal > 0)\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostRow.data() + state.rowBegin, dRow + state.rowBegin,\n                                      nLocal * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, hostRow.data(), state.rowCounts.data(),\n                           state.rowDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dRow, hostRow.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n\n        if (root && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps)) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (state.rank == 0) printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n    const int nLocal = state.numLocal;\n    std::vector<val_t> local(std::max(nLocal, 1));\n    if (nLocal > 0) {\n        distancesKernel<<<(nLocal + 127) / 128, 128>>>(\n            static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles), state.rowBegin, nLocal,\n            static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps), static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex),\n            state.dRadB, state.dDist);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(local.data(), state.dDist, nLocal * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n    MPI_Gatherv(local.data(), nLocal, MPI_FLOAT, state.distances.data(), state.rowCounts.data(),\n                state.rowDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[t * state.numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = static_cast<int>(state.nonZeroKij);\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nstatic double wallMs(MPI_Comm comm) {\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    return MPI_Wtime() * 1000.0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    int rank = 0, numRanks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &numRanks);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    // One GPU per rank (round-robin over the node's devices)\n    {\n        MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n        MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n        int localRank = 0;\n        MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n        int numDevices = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&numDevices));\n        if (numDevices == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % numDevices));\n    }\n\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n        printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n        printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n        printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n        printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    state.rank = rank;\n    state.numRanks = numRanks;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    if (root) printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    double startPre = wallMs(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    computeTimeDelays(state);\n    computeFormFactors(state);\n\n    double endPre = wallMs(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    long preDuration = static_cast<long>(endPre - startPre);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", preDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Simulation\n    double startSim = wallMs(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    runSimulation(state);\n\n    double endSim = wallMs(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    long simDuration = static_cast<long>(endSim - startSim);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", simDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Distance computation\n    double startDist = wallMs(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    computeDistances(state);\n\n    double endDist = wallMs(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    long distDuration = static_cast<long>(endDist - startDist);\n\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Distance computation time: %ld ms\\n\", distDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n\n        // Total time\n        long totalTime = preDuration + simDuration + distDuration;\n        printf(\"Total computation time: %ld ms\\n\", totalTime);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n        size_t t = state.numTimesteps;\n        double kijOps = static_cast<double>(n * n);\n        double simOps = static_cast<double>(n * n * t);\n        double distOps = static_cast<double>(n * t * t);\n\n        printf(\"\\nPerformance:\\n\");\n        printf(\"  Triangles: %zu\\n\", n);\n        printf(\"  Timesteps: %zu\\n\", t);\n        printf(\"  Form factor computations: %.2e\\n\", kijOps);\n        printf(\"  Simulation operations: %.2e\\n\", simOps);\n        printf(\"  Distance computations: %.2e\\n\", distOps);\n        printf(\"  Total time per triangle: %.4f ms\\n\", static_cast<double>(totalTime) / n);\n\n        // Memory usage\n        size_t memKij = n * n * sizeof(val_t);\n        size_t memTau = n * n * sizeof(int);\n        size_t memRad = 2 * t * n * sizeof(val_t);\n        size_t totalMem = memKij + memTau + memRad;\n        printf(\"  Memory usage: %.2f MB\\n\", totalMem / (1024.0 * 1024.0));\n\n        // Hash\n        uint64_t hash = computeHash(state);\n        printf(\"  Result hash: %016lX\\n\", hash);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n\n >> 6) - 1, (L + m) / 64 + 2);\n                xorShifted(C.data(), B.data(), std::max(bw, 0), static_cast<size_t>(m));\n                ++m;\n            }\n        }\n        if (L != MT_DEG) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"MT19937 characteristic polynomial: unexpected degree %d\\n\", L);\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        charPoly.assign(MT_POLY_W64, 0);\n        for (int k = 0; k <= MT_DEG; ++k) {\n            if (getBit(C, static_cast<size_t>(MT_DEG - k))) charPoly[k >> 6] |= 1ULL << (k & 63);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Table indexed by the 8 coefficients [MT_DEG, MT_DEG+7] of a multiple m(x)*P(x), deg m < 8\n    void buildReductionTable() {\n        redTable.assign(256 * MT_POLY_W64, 0);\n        for (int mm = 0; mm < 256; ++mm) {\n            std::vector<uint64_t> prod(MT_POLY_W64 + 1, 0);\n            for (int b = 0; b < 8; ++b)\n                if (mm & (1 << b)) xorShifted(prod.data(), charPoly.data(), MT_POLY_W64, b);\n            int h = static_cast<int>(getWord(prod, MT_DEG) & 0xff);\n            std::copy(prod.begin(), prod.begin() + MT_POLY_W64, redTable.begin() + h * MT_POLY_W64);\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<uint64_t> squareMod(const std::vector<uint64_t>& a) const {\n        std::vector<uint64_t> t(2 * MT_POLY_W64 + 4, 0);\n        auto spread = [](uint32_t v) {\n            uint64_t x = v;\n            x = (x | (x << 16)) & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFULL;\n            x = (x | (x << 8)) & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFULL;\n            x = (x | (x << 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0FULL;\n            x = (x | (x << 2)) & 0x3333333333333333ULL;\n            x = (x | (x << 1)) & 0x5555555555555555ULL;\n            return x;\n        };\n        for (int w = 0; w < MT_POLY_W64; ++w) {\n            t[2 * w] = spread(static_cast<uint32_t>(a[w]));\n            t[2 * w + 1] = spread(static_cast<uint32_t>(a[w] >> 32));\n        }\n        long top = 2L * (MT_DEG - 1);\n        for (; top - 7 >= MT_DEG; top -= 8) {\n            size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(top - 7);\n            int h = static_cast<int>(getWord(t, p) & 0xff);\n            if (h) xorShifted(t.data(), redTable.data() + h * MT_POLY_W64, MT_POLY_W64, p - MT_DEG);\n        }\n        for (; top >= MT_DEG; --top) {\n            if (getBit(t, static_cast<size_t>(top)))\n                xorShifted(t.data(), charPoly.data(), MT_POLY_W64, static_cast<size_t>(top - MT_DEG));\n        }\n        return std::vector<uint64_t>(t.begin(), t.begin() + MT_POLY_W64);\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device: MT19937 helpers\n// ============================================================================\n\n// In-place twist of a 624-word state in shared memory (requires blockDim.x >= 227)\n__device__ void blockTwist(uint32_t* mt) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    uint32_t v = 0;\n    if (tid < 227) v = mtTwistWord(mt[tid], mt[tid + 1], mt[tid + MT_M]);\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (tid < 227) mt[tid] = v;\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (tid < 227) { int k = tid + 227; v = mtTwistWord(mt[k], mt[k + 1], mt[k - 227]); }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (tid < 227) mt[tid + 227] = v;\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (tid < 170) { int k = tid + 454; v = mtTwistWord(mt[k], mt[(k + 1) % MT_N], mt[k - 227]); }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (tid < 170) mt[tid + 454] = v;\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// Same mapping as std::generate_canonical<float, 24>(mt19937) in libstdc++\n__device__ __forceinline__ float mtToUniform(uint32_t y) {\n    float r = __uint2float_rn(y) * 2.3283064365386962890625e-10f;  // / 2^32 (exact)\n    return r >= 1.0f ? 0x1.fffffep-1f : r;\n}\n\nconstexpr int JUMP_THREADS = 640;\n\n// out[c] = window(src advanced by base + c * stride)\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(JUMP_THREADS)\nmtJumpKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ src, unsigned long long base, unsigned long long stride,\n             const uint32_t* __restrict__ polys, uint32_t* __restrict__ out) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t st[MT_N];\n    __shared__ uint32_t buf[2 * MT_N];\n    __shared__ uint32_t q[MT_POLY_W32];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const unsigned long long off = base + static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockIdx.x) * stride;\n\n    if (tid < MT_N) st[tid] = src[tid];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < 64; ++b) {\n        if (!((off >> b) & 1ULL)) continue;\n        for (int k = tid; k < MT_POLY_W32; k += blockDim.x) q[k] = polys[static_cast<size_t>(b) * MT_POLY_W32 + k];\n        if (tid < MT_N) { buf[tid] = st[tid]; buf[MT_N + tid] = st[tid]; }\n        __syncthreads();\n        blockTwist(buf + MT_N);\n        uint32_t acc = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r * MT_N < MT_DEG; ++r) {\n            const int i0 = r * MT_N;\n            const int kmax = min(MT_N, MT_DEG - i0);\n            if (tid < MT_N) {\n                for (int k = 0; k < kmax; ++k) {\n                    int i = i0 + k;\n                    if ((q[i >> 5] >> (i & 31)) & 1u) acc ^= buf[k + tid];\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            if (tid < MT_N) buf[tid] = buf[MT_N + tid];\n            __syncthreads();\n            blockTwist(buf + MT_N);\n        }\n        if (tid < MT_N) st[tid] = acc;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (tid < MT_N) out[static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * MT_N + tid] = st[tid];\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device: geometry\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// Möller-Trumbore ray-triangle intersection\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                                      const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    const val_t NO_HIT = 3.402823466e+38f;\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return NO_HIT;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return NO_HIT;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return NO_HIT;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(const FlatNode& nd, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - nd.center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n    const Vec3& h = nd.halfExtent;\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > h.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > h.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > h.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > h.y * ad.z + h.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > h.z * ad.x + h.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > h.x * ad.y + h.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nconstexpr int OCT_STACK = 128;\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle (octree-accelerated)\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx,\n                             const FlatNode* __restrict__ nodes, const int* __restrict__ leafTris,\n                             const Triangle* __restrict__ tris) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[OCT_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const FlatNode& nd = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (nd.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < nd.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = leafTris[nd.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const Triangle& tri = tris[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;  // Ray is blocked\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Push in reverse so that children are visited in ascending order\n            for (int c = 7; c >= 0; --c) {\n                int ch = nd.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && rayIntersectsBox(nodes[ch], from, to)) stack[sp++] = ch;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    val_t c = v.dot(normal) / vNorm;\n    return (ZERO < c) ? c : ZERO;\n}\n\n// Contribution of a single ray to Kij (0 if the sequential code would `continue`)\n__device__ val_t rayContribution(int i, int j, const val_t* rnd,\n                                 const FlatNode* __restrict__ nodes, const int* __restrict__ leafTris,\n                                 const Triangle* __restrict__ tris) {\n    const Triangle triI = tris[i];\n    const Triangle triJ = tris[j];\n    Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rnd[0], rnd[1]);\n    Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rnd[2], rnd[3]);\n\n    if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, i, j, nodes, leafTris, tris)) return ZERO;\n\n    Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n    val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n    if (distSqr < EPSILON) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n    val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n    if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) return ZERO;\n\n    return (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n}\n\n// Triangles facing the same direction are culled (no random numbers consumed)\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool pairActive(const Vec3* __restrict__ normals, int i, int j, int n) {\n    return j < n && j != i && !(normals[i].dot(normals[j]) > 0.99f);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device: block scan helper\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Exclusive prefix count of `flag` across the block; returns the prefix, total in `total`.\n__device__ __forceinline__ int blockScan(bool flag, int* warpSums, int& total) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    const int nWarps = (blockDim.x + 31) >> 5;\n    unsigned bal = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, flag);\n    int pre = __popc(bal & ((1u << lane) - 1u));\n    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = __popc(bal);\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        int s = 0;\n        for (int w = 0; w < nWarps; ++w) { int v = warpSums[w]; warpSums[w] = s; s += v; }\n        warpSums[32] = s;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    pre += warpSums[warp];\n    total = warpSums[32];\n    __syncthreads();\n    return pre;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device: form factor kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void countActivePairsKernel(const Vec3* __restrict__ normals, int n, int* __restrict__ rowCount) {\n    __shared__ int warpSums[33];\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    int cnt = 0;\n    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < n; j0 += blockDim.x) {\n        int tot;\n        blockScan(pairActive(normals, i, j0 + threadIdx.x, n), warpSums, tot);\n        cnt += tot;\n    }\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) rowCount[i] = cnt;\n}\n\nconstexpr int FF_THREADS = 256;\nconstexpr int FF_BATCH = 64;   // pairs per batch\n\n// Each block handles one chunk of `pairsPerChunk` consecutive non-culled pairs (in the\n// sequential row-major order), starting from the matching MT19937 state.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(FF_THREADS)\nformFactorKernel(int n, int rowBegin, int nLocal,\n                 long long pairBegin, long long pairEnd, long long pairsPerChunk,\n                 const long long* __restrict__ rowOffset, const uint32_t* __restrict__ chunkStates,\n                 const Vec3* __restrict__ normals, const Triangle* __restrict__ tris,\n                 const FlatNode* __restrict__ nodes, const int* __restrict__ leafTris,\n                 val_t* __restrict__ kijT) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t sMt[MT_N];\n    __shared__ val_t sRnd[FF_BATCH * DRAWS_PER_PAIR];\n    __shared__ val_t sTerm[FF_BATCH * NUM_RAYS];\n    __shared__ int sPI[FF_BATCH], sPJ[FF_BATCH];\n    __shared__ int warpSums[33];\n    __shared__ int sRow, sCol;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const long long pStart = pairBegin + static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * pairsPerChunk;\n    const long long pEnd = min(pStart + pairsPerChunk, pairEnd);\n\n    for (int k = tid; k < MT_N; k += blockDim.x) sMt[k] = chunkStates[static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * MT_N + k];\n    if (tid == 0) {\n        // Largest row i with rowOffset[i] <= pStart\n        int lo = 0, hi = n - 1;\n        while (lo < hi) {\n            int mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1;\n            if (rowOffset[mid] <= pStart) lo = mid; else hi = mid - 1;\n        }\n        sRow = lo;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Locate the column of the first pair of this chunk\n    int ci = sRow;\n    long long k = pStart - rowOffset[ci];\n    int cj = 0;\n    while (true) {\n        int col = cj + tid;\n        bool f = pairActive(normals, ci, col, n);\n        int tot;\n        int pre = blockScan(f, warpSums, tot);\n        if (k < tot) {\n            if (f && pre == k) sCol = col;\n            __syncthreads();\n            cj = sCol;\n            break;\n        }\n        k -= tot;\n        cj += blockDim.x;\n    }\n\n    int pos = MT_N;   // forces a twist before the first draw\n    long long remaining = pEnd - pStart;\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        const int cap = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<long long>(FF_BATCH), remaining));\n        int nb = 0;\n        // Gather the next `cap` active pairs\n        while (nb < cap) {\n            int col = cj + tid;\n            bool f = ci < n && pairActive(normals, ci, col, n);\n            int tot;\n            int pre = blockScan(f, warpSums, tot);\n            int take           __syncthreads();\n            if (tot > take) cj = sCol + 1; else cj += blockDim.x;\n            nb += take;\n            if (cj >= n) { ++ci; cj = 0; }\n        }\n\n        // Random numbers for this batch (in stream order)\n        const int need = nb * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n        int filled = 0;\n        while (filled < need) {\n            if (pos == MT_N) { blockTwist(sMt); pos = 0; }\n            int cnt = min(MT_N - pos, need - filled);\n            for (int t = tid; t < cnt; t += blockDim.x) sRnd[filled + t] = mtToUniform(mtTemper(sMt[pos + t]));\n            filled += cnt;\n            pos += cnt;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // One ray per task\n        for (int t = tid; t < nb * NUM_RAYS; t += blockDim.x) {\n            int p = t / NUM_RAYS;\n            int r = t % NUM_RAYS;\n            sTerm[t] = rayContribution(sPI[p], sPJ[p], sRnd + p * DRAWS_PER_PAIR + 4 * r, nodes, leafTris, tris);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Accumulate rays in sequential order\n        if (tid < nb) {\n            val_t kij = ZERO;\n            for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) kij += sTerm[tid * NUM_RAYS + r];\n            kijT[static_cast<size_t>(sPJ[tid]) * nLocal + (sPI[tid] - rowBegin)] = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        remaining -= nb;\n    }\n}\n\n// Count Kij > EPSILON, then replace Kij by the propagation weight min(Kij * A_j, 1)\n// (0 where Kij <= 0, which the simulation skips).\n__global__ void finalizeWeightsKernel(val_t* __restrict__ kijT, const val_t* __restrict__ areas,\n                                      int n, int nLocal, unsigned long long* __restrict__ nonZero) {\n    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(n) * nLocal;\n    unsigned long long cnt = 0;\n    for (size_t e = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x; e < total;\n         e += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {\n        val_t kij = kijT[e];\n        if (kij > EPSILON) ++cnt;\n        val_t w = ZERO;\n        if (kij > ZERO) {\n            val_t p = kij * areas[e / nLocal];\n            w = (ONE < p) ? ONE : p;\n        }\n        kijT[e] = w;\n    }\n    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) cnt += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, cnt, o);\n    if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0 && cnt) atomicAdd(nonZero, cnt);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device: simulation and distances\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int SIM_THREADS = 64;\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SIM_THREADS)\nsimulationStepKernel(int t, int n, int rowBegin, int nLocal,\n                     const val_t* __restrict__ weightT, const uint8_t* __restrict__ tauT,\n                     val_t* __restrict__ radB, val_t rho, int sourceIdx, int timeOff) {\n    const int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= nLocal) return;\n    const int i = rowBegin + li;\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    const val_t* wp = weightT + li;\n    const uint8_t* tp = tauT + li;\n    #pragma unroll 4\n    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        int tauij = tp[static_cast<size_t>(j) * nLocal];\n        val_t w = wp[static_cast<size_t>(j) * nLocal];\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i, or no coupling\n        if (t >= tauij && w > ZERO) {\n            val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * n + j];\n            if (radJ > ZERO) sumB += w * radJ;\n        }\n    }\n    val_t radE = (i == sourceIdx && t < timeOff) ? 1.0f : ZERO;\n    radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i] = rho * sumB + radE;\n}\n\n__global__ void distancesKernel(int n, int rowBegin, int nLocal, int numT, int sourceIdx,\n                                const val_t* __restrict__ radB, val_t* __restrict__ distances) {\n    const int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= nLocal) return;\n    const int i = rowBegin + li;\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (int t = 0; t < numT; ++t) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < numT; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * n + i];\n            val_t pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * n + sourceIdx];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n    distances[li] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    const bool root = state.rank == 0;\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = Vec3 {\n    val_t x, y, z;\n\n    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}\n    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) {}\n\n    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }\n    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }\n    Vec3 operator*(val_t s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }\n    Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }\n    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }\n\n    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }\n    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};\n    }\n\n    val_t squaredNorm() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }\n    val_t norm() const { return std::sqrt(squaredNorm()); }\n    Vec3 normalized() const {\n        val_t n = norm();\n        return n > EPSILON ? *this / n : Vec3();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return std::abs(x - o.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - o.y) < EPSILON && std::abs(z - o.z) < EPSILON;\n    }\n};\n\nstruct Triangle {\n    Vec3 a, b, c;\n    Vec3 _normal;\n\n    Triangle() = default;\n    Triangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c)\n        : a(a), b(b), c(c), _normal((b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()) {}\n\n    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }\n    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }\n\n    val_t area() const {\n        Vec3 ab = b - a;\n        Vec3 ac = c - a;\n        return 0.5f * ab.cross(ac).norm();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Triangle& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\npublic:\n    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n        }\n        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n Later runs are steady.\n- **Build requirements:** CMake ≥ 3.24 (for `CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native`).
